intent: Follow the shape of the river from a straight bank, around its bend, over eroded cliffs and along the wet inner bank to a viewpoint.

sections.name: The straight riverbank
sections.lesson: Build your rhythm along the bank

signs.text:
The straight riverbank
Build your rhythm along the bank

sections.name: Around the sweeping bend
sections.lesson: The route doubles around the river’s stone shoulders

signs.text:
Around the sweeping bend
The route doubles around the river’s stone shoulders

The eroded outer bank
Climb the exposed outer face

sections.name: The wet inner bank
sections.lesson: Descend to the sheltered wet bank

signs.text:
The wet inner bank
Descend to the sheltered wet bank

sections.name: The river viewpoint
sections.lesson: Rise once more to see the full bend

signs.text:
The river viewpoint
Rise once more to see the full bend
